text:
Ellen Park: hi all, onboarding question about org ownerships. i'm mapping who to contact for different things (infra, model onboarding, security reviews). is there a single org chart or directory?
Ravi Shah: hey ellen, welcome! we have a lightweight org map in the internal wiki: /handbook/org-map. but the canonical source for service-level owners is `infra/OWNERS.md` in each repo.
Ellen Park: thanks. i'm trying to figure out who signs off on model eval infra (cpu/gpu requests) vs who approves model access for prod data.
Kait Gomez: model infra (allocation of GPUs, IL) is handled by Eng-ML and Platform jointly. Eng-ML approves model evaluation infra, Platform provisions capacity. For prod data access and redaction approvals you need Security and Privacy signoff.
Ellen Park: ok who do i ping for a Privacy review?
Kait Gomez: privacy requests go to privacy@redwood-infer.com. Security reviews use the security-review form (link in handbook). People Ops also needs to be cc'd if it's an external collaborator.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: Any access that allows PII processing requires manager + privacy team approval. Add justification and retention period.
Ellen Park: good to know. what's the escalation flow if Platform is slow on GPU provisioning and the eval window is blocked?
Ravi Shah: escalation path: 1) open a ticket in INFRA tracker and tag #eng-ml and #eng-infra, 2) if no action in 60m and it's blocking prod timelines, page eng-oncall and mention the ticket, 3) if it's customer-impacting, follow the incident playbook and involve your PM and Eng manager.
Ellen Park: is there a list of oncall rotations for Platform so i can see who to page?
Kait Gomez: yes, Platform oncall roster is in /handbook/oncall/rosters. Also each INFRA ticket auto-notifies the oncall via infra-bot.
infra-bot: INFRA-4210 created by Ravi Shah: "gpu quota request for ellen.park@redwood-infer.com" assignee: platform-oncall status: open
Ellen Park: perfect. one last thing: if the OWNERS file is stale (no response), who is allowed to update it?
Ravi Shah: repo owners can update OWNERS via a PR. If you're unsure, file an issue and ping the repo's team alias (found in CODEOWNERS). If the team is dissolved, Platform will migrate ownership to infra-team and add a backup contact.
Ellen Park: thanks everyone — super helpful. saving for the onboarding notes. :tada:
Kait Gomez: welcome aboard! feel free to DM if you want a quick walkthrough of the org map.
